description: Auth, session/profile, roles, officer admin UI, and the mutation layer; plus the full RLS verification artifacts. Builds SessionProvider (session + profile row + role), AuthDialog (email/password AND Google OAuth), AdminPanel (officers-only promote/demote with self-demote UX guard), the Header auth/admin entry points, and src/data/mutations.ts (thin RLS-trusting wrappers incl. setRole). Fills in SETUP.md RLS proof steps and ships the role-only self-escalation negative test gate (fix #1). Depends on FEAT-001 (Supabase client, migration, types). Anonymous read must remain unaffected — no auth gating on data access.
steps: Create src/context/SessionProvider.tsx: subscribe to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange; on a session fetch the profiles row for auth.uid() (role + theme_preferences); retry the profile fetch once after a short delay if a session exists but no row (handle_new_user lag) then default to member; on sign-out profile=null (anonymous). Expose { session, profile, role: profile?.role ?? null, isOfficer, refreshProfile }. If supabase is null (unconfigured) the provider must no-op safely (App renders ConfigError before this anyway).

Create src/components/AuthDialog.tsx: email/password sign-in + sign-up via supabase.auth, and Google OAuth via supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider:'google' }) (detectSessionInUrl completes the redirect). Real <button> elements with visible focus. Inline Supabase error messages on bad credentials / OAuth failure. Never force sign-in — the dialog is opened from the Header.

Create src/data/mutations.ts: addTask, removeTask, setTaskStatus, upsertSubject + schedule-slot writes, and setRole(userId, role) = supabase.from('profiles').update({ role }).eq('id', userId). All are thin wrappers that trust RLS for authorization and NEVER check a client role. No optimistic UI; on RLS denial surface a toast like 'Only officers can do that'; on network error 'Couldn't save, try again' with no state change.

Create src/components/AdminPanel.tsx (officers only, opened from Header): list profiles (name/role only, not emails per Security Notes), promote/demote via setRole backed by Policy B. Disable the demote control on the current user's own row with a tooltip ('You can't demote yourself') — a UX guard, not a security boundary. Add the admin entry point + 'Officers can edit' tag + Sign in / profile menu to src/components/Header.tsx (all real <button>s with focus rings).

Add component tests (RTL): AuthDialog renders real <button>s and shows inline error on failed sign-in; AdminPanel renders for officer role and the demote control is disabled on the current user's own row; officer-only Header controls are absent for member and anonymous (role null).

Author the RLS integration/verification suite and documentation (fix #1 + fix #3 test gates). If a live Supabase project is reachable in CI, write integration tests (e.g. supabase/tests or src/__tests__/rls.integration.test.ts, clearly marked, skipped when env is absent); otherwise ship a clearly-marked test harness script + documented manual steps in SETUP.md. Cases MUST include: anon SELECT works on all four tables; anon AND member INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on tasks are rejected; member update({ name }) and update({ theme_preferences }) SUCCEED; the PURE-ESCALATION negative case member update({ role:'officer' }).eq('id', self) with NO other column changed is REJECTED; member update({ name, role:'officer' }) rejected; officer promote/demote of ANOTHER user succeeds; and (fix #3) an officer attempting to write ANOTHER user's theme_preferences via direct update is rejected (only Policy A / the row owner can write theme_preferences).

Fill in the SETUP.md RLS-proof section with the concrete curl / supabase-js snippets for the cases above (anon read ok; anon/member write denied; role-only self-escalation denied; officer role change ok; officer cross-user theme write denied), and mark which run automatically vs manually.
Commit locally on branch classboard via git -C c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: SessionProvider exposes session/profile/role/isOfficer and never gates the data hooks on auth (anonymous read preserved).
AuthDialog supports both email/password and Google OAuth; all controls are real <button>s with visible focus.
mutations.ts contains no client-side role check for authorization; setRole issues update({ role }).eq('id', userId).
AdminPanel disables self-demote and only exposes name/role.

The required RLS test gate exists and includes the pure-escalation negative case update({ role:'officer' }) with no other column change rejected, the member update({name})/update({theme_preferences}) success cases, officer role change success, and the officer cross-user theme_preferences write rejection; it is runnable against a live backend and documented with manual steps when none is available.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` all pass in the worktree.
verification: npm run test -> component tests pass; RLS integration tests pass against a live backend when SUPABASE env is set, otherwise are skipped-with-reason and the manual steps are present in SETUP.md
If a live Supabase project is configured, run the RLS suite and confirm the pure-escalation negative case is REJECTED and the member theme/name self-updates SUCCEED

Verified in worktree: npm run typecheck clean (0 errors); npm run lint = 0 errors (1 pre-existing-style WARNING only: react-refresh/only-export-components on SessionProvider.tsx because it exports both the SessionProvider component and the useSession hook — standard React Context pattern, config only warns via allowConstantExport, lint exits 0); npm run test = 46 passed | 9 skipped (the 9 are the RLS integration suite, skipped-with-reason because live Supabase env is unset); npm run build OK.

FILES ADDED:
- src/context/SessionProvider.tsx: SessionProvider + useSession(). Subscribes to supabase.auth.getSession() then onAuthStateChange; on a session fetches profiles row (id,name,email,role,theme_preferences) via maybeSingle, retries ONCE after 600ms if no row (handle_new_user trigger lag), then defaults to a member profile so UI stays usable. Uses a currentUserId ref to drop results from a stale/switched user. On sign-out profile=null (anonymous). Exposes { session, profile, role: profile?.role ?? null, isOfficer, refreshProfile }. No-ops when supabase is null. NEVER gates anything on auth. theme_preferences parsed via normalizePrefs.
- src/data/mutations.ts: addTask, removeTask, setTaskStatus, upsertSubject, removeSubject, upsertScheduleSlot, removeScheduleSlot, and setRole(userId,role)=supabase.from('profiles').update({role}).eq('id',userId). ALL thin RLS-trusting wrappers, NO client role check anywhere, no optimistic UI. Return MutationResult {ok, error?: 'not-configured'|'denied'|'network'}; classify() maps Postgres 42xxx / RLS / permission-denied messages to 'denied', else 'network'. MUTATION_MESSAGES: denied->'Only officers can do that', network/not-configured->"Couldn't save, try again". Row writes map camelCase->snake_case (subject_id, given_date, deadline, created_by, start_time, end_time).
- src/components/AuthDialog.tsx: email/password signInWithPassword + signUp (handles email-confirm no-session case with a notice), Google via signInWithOAuth({provider:'google', options:{redirectTo: window.location.origin}}) relying on detectSessionInUrl. All real <button>s; inline role="alert" error from Supabase messages. Styled only via tokens (var(--accent)/--accent-contrast fills, --accent-text links, --danger errors). Never forces sign-in; opened from Header.
- src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: officers-only (rendered from Header when isOfficer; still trusts Policy B). Lists profiles by name + role ONLY (select 'id, name, role' — never email). Promote/demote via setRole then reloads. Self-row demote button disabled with title "You can't demote yourself" (UX guard, NOT a security boundary). Errors shown via MUTATION_MESSAGES.
- src/components/Header.tsx: title + 'Officers can edit' tag (always shown) + Members(admin) button (officer-only) + Sign in / name+Sign out. All real <button>s. Opens AuthDialog/AdminPanel in a fixed overlay. signOut via supabase.auth.signOut.
- src/App.tsx: now wraps the shell in <SessionProvider> and renders <Header/> above a placeholder main. Still renders <ConfigError/> when !isConfigured. Data access NOT gated on auth (anonymous visitors see the shell).

TESTS ADDED (RTL, jsdom):
- AuthDialog.test.tsx: submit + Google are real BUTTON tagName; inline role=alert error on failed sign-in; Google button invokes signInWithOAuth({provider:'google'}).
- AdminPanel.test.tsx: renders for officer; TWO demote buttons (both officers in fixture), self-row (Alice) demote disabled + title tooltip, other officer (Bob) enabled; email not rendered + select scoped to 'id, name, role'.
- Header.test.tsx: Members control present for officer, absent for member AND anonymous (role null); 'Officers can edit' tag always present; Sign in offered when anonymous.
- MOCK GOTCHA: vi.mock factories must NOT close over plain top-level vars (hoisting -> ReferenceError 'Cannot access X before initialization'). Define mock fns inside vi.hoisted(() => ({...})) and destructure. Applied to all three component tests. Later component tests should do the same.

RLS GATE: src/__tests__/rls.integration.test.ts (// @vitest-environment node). Skipped-with-reason (console.warn + describe.skip) unless env RLS_TEST_SUPABASE_URL/RLS_TEST_ANON_KEY/RLS_TEST_MEMBER_EMAIL+PASSWORD/RLS_TEST_OFFICER_EMAIL+PASSWORD/RLS_TEST_TARGET_PROFILE_ID are ALL set. When live it signs in member+officer via anon-key signInWithPassword (no service role) and asserts: anon SELECT ok on all 4 tables; anon + member task INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE rejected; member update({name}) and update({theme_preferences}) SUCCEED; PURE-ESCALATION member update({role:'officer'}).eq('id',self) with NO other column REJECTED + stored role still 'member'; member update({name,role:'officer'}) REJECTED; officer promote/demote of ANOTHER user SUCCEEDS; officer CROSS-USER theme_preferences write REJECTED. Restores member name + target role in afterAll. NOT run here (no live backend); manual curl + env steps documented in SETUP.md section 7.

SETUP.md section 7 filled: verification table, the automated-run env var list, and curl snippets for every case (anon read ok; anon/member write denied; member self name/theme ok; pure role self-escalation denied; officer role change ok; officer cross-user theme write denied), marked automated-vs-manual.

NOTE for FEAT-005 (theme): ThemeProvider must persist to BOTH localStorage key 'cb-theme' and profiles.theme_preferences; the member self-theme-save path is proven by the RLS gate (Policy A via current_role_of). SessionProvider.refreshProfile() can be called after a theme save to re-sync.
